result.instructions: Tools for Momence, hosted by usefulapi.io. Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Momence data. Free plan: 100 tool calls per month. Run momence_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run momence_request_feature to record the request. Pro (unlimited calls, $9/month or $90/year): when the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run momence_upgrade; it returns a Stripe Checkout link for the user to open. momence_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: momence_get_current_user
tools.title: Get the logged-in user
tools.description: Return the staff user the API is acting as (userId, email, name). A cheap way to confirm the credentials work. Momence: GET /api/v2/auth/profile.

tools.name: momence_list_members
tools.title: List members
tools.description: List or search the studio's customers (members), with visit counts, custom fields and tags. Search by name, email or phone with `query`; use filterPreset=with-active-membership for current members. Momence: GET /api/v2/host/members.

query.description: Search customers by name, email or phone.

filterPreset.description: Only customers with an active membership.

staticSegmentId.description: Only customers in this static segment.

tools.name: momence_get_member
tools.title: Get one member
tools.description: Fetch one customer by id: contact details, first/last seen, visit counts, custom fields and tags. Momence: GET /api/v2/host/members/{memberId}.

tools.name: momence_list_member_session_bookings
tools.title: List a member's class bookings
tools.description: List the class/session bookings of one member, with the session details and check-in state. Momence: GET /api/v2/host/members/{memberId}/sessions.

startAfter.description: Only sessions starting after (ISO 8601 date-time, e.g. 2026-10-01T00:00:00Z).

startBefore.description: Only sessions starting before (ISO 8601 date-time, e.g. 2026-10-01T00:00:00Z).

endAfter.description: Only sessions ending after (ISO 8601 date-time, e.g. 2026-10-01T00:00:00Z).

endBefore.description: Only sessions ending before (ISO 8601 date-time, e.g. 2026-10-01T00:00:00Z).

tools.name: momence_list_member_appointments
tools.title: List a member's appointments
tools.description: List the appointment reservations (1:1 services) of one member. Momence: GET /api/v2/host/members/{memberId}/appointments.

startAfter.description: Only appointments starting after (ISO 8601 date-time, e.g. 2026-10-01T00:00:00Z).

startBefore.description: Only appointments starting before (ISO 8601 date-time, e.g. 2026-10-01T00:00:00Z).

endAfter.description: Only appointments ending after (ISO 8601 date-time, e.g. 2026-10-01T00:00:00Z).

endBefore.description: Only appointments ending before (ISO 8601 date-time, e.g. 2026-10-01T00:00:00Z).

tools.name: momence_list_member_notes
tools.title: List a member's notes
tools.description: List the staff notes (regular and SOAP) recorded on one member. Momence: GET /api/v2/host/members/{memberId}/notes.

tools.name: momence_list_member_memberships
tools.title: List a member's active memberships
tools.description: List one member's active subscriptions and class packs (bought memberships): type, dates, credits left, usage limits and freeze state. Momence: GET /api/v2/host/members/{memberId}/bought-memberships/active.

tools.name: momence_list_sessions
tools.title: List sessions (classes)
tools.description: List the studio's scheduled sessions — classes, events, courses — with time, teacher, location, capacity and booking count. Filter by date window, type, teacher or location. Momence: GET /api/v2/host/sessions.

startAfter.description: Only sessions starting after (ISO 8601 date-time, e.g. 2026-10-01T00:00:00Z).

startBefore.description: Only sessions starting before (ISO 8601 date-time, e.g. 2026-10-01T00:00:00Z).

endAfter.description: Only sessions ending after (ISO 8601 date-time, e.g. 2026-10-01T00:00:00Z).

endBefore.description: Only sessions ending before (ISO 8601 date-time, e.g. 2026-10-01T00:00:00Z).

teacherId.description: Only sessions taught by this teacher.

includeChildLocations.description: With locationId, also include its child locations.

tools.name: momence_get_session
tools.title: Get one session
tools.description: Fetch one session's detail: times, capacity and booking count, waitlist capacity and count, teachers, location, online stream details and tags. Momence: GET /api/v2/host/sessions/{sessionId}.

tools.name: momence_list_session_bookings
tools.title: List a session's bookings (roster)
tools.description: List who is booked into one session — the class roster — with each booking's id, member, check-in state and recurring-booking id. Momence: GET /api/v2/host/sessions/{sessionId}/bookings.

tools.name: momence_list_appointments
tools.title: List appointment reservations
tools.description: List all appointment reservations across the studio (service, teacher, time, price, paid state, attendees). Momence: GET /api/v2/host/appointments/reservations.

startAfter.description: Only appointments starting after (ISO 8601 date-time, e.g. 2026-10-01T00:00:00Z).

startBefore.description: Only appointments starting before (ISO 8601 date-time, e.g. 2026-10-01T00:00:00Z).

endAfter.description: Only appointments ending after (ISO 8601 date-time, e.g. 2026-10-01T00:00:00Z).

endBefore.description: Only appointments ending before (ISO 8601 date-time, e.g. 2026-10-01T00:00:00Z).

tools.name: momence_list_memberships
tools.title: List membership plans
tools.description: List the membership plans the studio sells (subscriptions, class packs, money packs): pricing, duration, credits, usage limits, trial and intro-offer flags. Optionally only plans usable for a given session or appointment. Momence: GET /api/v2/host/memberships.

compatibleWithSessionId.description: Only plans that can pay for this session.

compatibleWithAppointmentId.description: Only plans that can pay for this appointment.

tools.name: momence_list_tags
tools.title: List customer tags
tools.description: List the customer tags defined for the studio (ids for momence_set_member_tag). Momence: GET /api/v2/host/tags.

tools.name: momence_list_customer_leads
tools.title: List customer leads
tools.description: List the studio's sales leads, open and converted (a non-null memberId means converted). Filter by search text, lead source or pipeline stage; resolve the ids with momence_list_lead_sources / momence_list_lead_stages. Momence: GET /api/v2/host/customer-leads.

query.description: Search leads by first name, last name, email or phone.

sourceId.description: Only leads from this lead source.

stageId.description: Only leads in this lead stage.

tools.name: momence_list_lead_sources
tools.title: List lead sources
tools.description: List lead sources (resolves the sourceId on customer leads). Momence: GET /api/v2/host/customer-lead-sources.

tools.name: momence_list_lead_stages
tools.title: List lead stages
tools.description: List lead pipeline stages (resolves the stageId on customer leads). Momence: GET /api/v2/host/customer-lead-stages.

tools.name: momence_create_member
tools.title: Add a member
tools.description: Add a new customer to the studio. Returns the new memberId. Momence: POST /api/v2/host/members.

tools.name: momence_update_member
tools.title: Update a member's name, email or phone
tools.description: Correct a customer's contact details. Give firstName+lastName together to rename, and/or email, and/or phoneNumber; each is a separate Momence call (PUT /api/v2/host/members/{memberId}/name, /email, /phone-number) and they run in that order, stopping at the first failure.

annotations.title: Update a member's name, email or phone

tools.name: momence_set_member_tag
tools.title: Tag or untag a member
tools.description: Assign a customer tag to a member (assigned=true) or remove it (assigned=false). Fully reversible. Tag ids come from momence_list_tags. Momence: POST / DELETE /api/v2/host/members/{memberId}/tags/{tagId}.

assigned.description: true to assign the tag, false to remove it.

tools.name: momence_book_member_free
tools.title: Book a member into a session for free
tools.description: Add a member to a session at no charge (a comp booking), optionally as a recurring booking for every occurrence of a recurring class. Returns the sessionBookingId. Undo with momence_cancel_session_booking. Momence: POST /api/v2/host/sessions/{sessionId}/bookings/free.

createRecurringBooking.description: Also book every future occurrence (recurring sessions only).

annotations.title: Book a member into a session for free

tools.name: momence_add_member_to_waitlist
tools.title: Add a member to a session waitlist
tools.description: Put a member on a session's waitlist. If a spot opens and they are booked from the waitlist, Momence uses the best matching bought membership unless you name specific ones in useBoughtMembershipIds. Returns the waitlistBookingId. Momence: POST /api/v2/host/sessions/{sessionId}/waitlist/bookings.

useBoughtMembershipIds.description: Bought memberships to try when booking from the waitlist.

annotations.title: Add a member to a session waitlist

tools.name: momence_set_booking_check_in
tools.title: Check a booking in or out
tools.description: Mark a session booking as checked in (checkedIn=true) or undo the check-in (checkedIn=false). Booking ids come from momence_list_session_bookings. Momence: POST / DELETE /api/v2/host/session-bookings/{bookingId}/check-in.

checkedIn.description: true to check in, false to undo the check-in.

annotations.title: Check a booking in or out

tools.name: momence_cancel_session_booking
tools.title: Cancel one session booking
tools.description: Cancel a SINGLE session booking (not a recurring series). By default: NO refund, NOT treated as a late cancellation (no penalty), and the member IS notified. Set refund=true only to return the member's payment or credit; isLateCancellation=true applies the studio's late-cancel policy. Not undoable except by re-booking. Momence: DELETE /api/v2/host/session-bookings/{bookingId}.

refund.description: Refund the member's payment/credit for this booking (default false).

isLateCancellation.description: Treat as a late cancellation under the studio policy (default false).

disableNotifications.description: Suppress the cancellation notification to the member (default false).
